issue: HoBo Fleet L26: behaviour and acceptance (wave 6)

cascadeDeltas.change: Add @hobo/fleet-agent as a devDependency; the O2 integration test and the soak reach its sandboxDrivers and createEgressProxyFactory by path until then.
Log the callout decision time as decision_ms on hobo_fleet_bus_status (component callout) and hobo_fleet_callout_refused; O20's callout_p99_ms has no other source and the soak fails without it.
Report the recorder's lag (for example a hobo_fleet_recorder_lag log event or a readable figure); the soak approximates zero lag as the journal count holding still for 15 s.

Run pnpm run fleet:soak on a GitHub-hosted Ubuntu runner after building the :candidate fleet images and provisioning the sandbox runtime (D58); it needs Docker Compose and pulls nats:2.15.3-alpine and openbao/openbao:2.4.1.
None needed: features/fleet/*.feature and features/steps/**/*.ts are already loaded; test:behavior takes about 65 s longer with the fleet scenarios.

requirementChanges: The O2 integration test fails, never skips, without nats-server or an S1 driver: L26's skips_allowed is false and O2 takes no fallback, which overrides the skip-outside-CI half of §11.3 rule 10.
The acceptance world imports the memory plumbing of @hobo/fleet/testing by path, because that barrel loads vitest through the conformance suites and cucumber cannot.
Behaviour steps reach the fleet packages through packages/fleet-authority/acceptance/index.ts, since the root workspace has no fleet dependencies.
The soak enrolls a fourth, observer-only member to open the fresh connections new_connection_failures counts; the three working agents are the soak's load.
The soak's operator signs in through an OIDC issuer the soak serves itself, and OpenBao runs in dev mode with JWT auth in a soak-written compose override; neither is committed under deploy/fleet.
